DIAGNOSIS READY: L5-S1 Lumbar Disc Herniation causing radiculopathy.

The MRI confirms a disc herniation at L5-S1 impinging on the nerve root, which explains your sharp pain radiating to your foot. This clinical picture is consistent with a herniated disc pressing on the sciatic nerve.
